_about: Andrew Gray (1633-1656), minister of the Outer High Church, Glasgow, dead at 22: The Works of the Reverend and Pious Andrew Gray, his sermon collections (The Mystery of Faith Opened, The Great Salvation, Directions and Instigations to the Duty of Prayer, and the rest), with a preface by William K. Tweedie (Aberdeen: George King, 1839). Named andrew-gray because 'gray' is a common word; the name check looks for 'Andrew Gray'.
